fields.title: Hybrid EV servicing Long Eaton

fields.editor:
Just like traditional petrol or diesel cars, electric vehicles (EVs) require regular maintenance to ensure optimal performance and longevity. EV servicing involves a comprehensive check of the vehicle's components, including:

  • Battery: We'll check the battery's health, including its state of charge, capacity, and internal resistance.
  • Electric Motor: We'll inspect the electric motor for any signs of wear or damage.
  • Power Electronics: We'll examine the power electronics, including the inverter, on-board charger, and battery management system.
  • High-Voltage Components: We'll check the high-voltage cables, connectors, and cooling system.
  • Software Updates: Updating the vehicle's software to improve performance and address any issues.
  • Brake System Inspection: Checking brake pads, discs, and brake fluid levels.
  • Safety: Servicing helps identify and address potential safety issues before they become serious problems.

By prioritising regular EV servicing, you can enjoy a safe, efficient, and reliable driving experience.
